Dear Sir, 
 
Sub.: Outcome of the meeting of the Board of Directors held on 18th November, 2026. 
Ref.: Our Outcome Board Meeting held on 12th November, 2026. 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 
2015, (“SEBI Listing Regulations”), we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of W.S. Industries 
(India) Limited (“the Company”), at its meeting held today, i.e., Wednesday, 18th November, 2026, 
inter-alia., considered and approved / accorded in-principle approval for certain strategic initiatives 
relating to the proposed entry into the Data Centres and Digital Infrastructure business and strategic 
investment in EPC (Engineering, Procurement and Construction) business entities to have controlling 
interest. The Board also took note of the civil sub-contracts secured by the Company from M/s. CMK 
Projects Private Limited. 
The Board, having considered the nature, strategic significance and potential implications of the 
following matters for the Company's business operations, future growth plans and stakeholders, was 
of the opinion that the same merit disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations, read 
with the applicable materiality criteria and the Company's Policy for Determination of Materiality of 
Events or Information. Accordingly, the Company is voluntarily disclosing the following decisions in 
the interest of transparency and informed investor communication, notwithstanding that the matters 
are not specifically enumerated as individual events under Part A of Schedule III to the SEBI LODR 
Regulations. 
1. Engagement of International Consultant for Data Centre Business 
The Board considered and approved the engagement of The Boston Consulting Group (India) 
Private Limited and The Boston Consulting Group UK LLP (collectively referred to as "BCG") 
as consultants for the Company's proposed Data Centre Business Build Project, subject to the 
terms and conditions approved by the Board and execution of the requisite engagement 
arrangements. 
 
 

W.S. Industries (India) Limited 
 
 
 
P a g e  | 2 
Registered Office: 3rd Floor, New No.48, Old No. 21, Savidhaanu Building, Casa Major Road, Egmore, Chennai - 600 008, 
                                Tamil Nadu, India. 
Contact                : (91) - 89258 02400                                     CIN              : L42909TN1961PLC004568 
                                                     Dept E-mail  : sectl@wsigroup.in   
                                                                                                   Website         : wsindustries.in 
2. In-principle Approval for Strategic Initiatives Relating to Data Centre  
The Board accorded its in-principle approval for the following proposals in connection with 
the Company's proposed entry into the Data Centre and Digital Infrastructure business: 
 
a) Alteration of the Memorandum of Association of the Company 
 
Approved the proposal for rationalisation and abridgement of the existing Main 
Objects Clause (Clause III(a)) of the Memorandum of Association of the Company, 
including restructuring and consolidation of the existing objects, wherever considered 
appropriate, and insertion of additional objects relating to Data Centres, colocation 
facilities, server farms and allied digital infrastructure activities, with a view to 
aligning the objects of the Company with its proposed business strategy and 
operational requirements, subject to the approval of the shareholders by way of a 
special resolution and completion of the requisite statutory and regulatory formalities. 
 
b) Proposed Change of Name of Wholly Owned Subsidiary 
 
Accorded in-principle approval to explore and identify a suitable new name for the 
Company's wholly owned subsidiary, M/s. WSI-P&C Verticals Private Limited, in 
alignment with its proposed business activities relating to Data Centres and allied 
digital infrastructure, subject to availability of the proposed name, requisite corporate 
approvals and statutory formalities. 
 
c) Proposed Increase in Authorised Share Capital of Wholly Owned Subsidiary  
Accorded in-principle approval for the proposal to increase the authorised share 
capital of M/s. WSI-P&C Verticals Private Limited from the existing ₹10 lakh to ₹5 
crore, subject to the requisite corporate approvals, alteration of its Memorandum of 
Association, wherever applicable, and completion of the statutory formalities. 
 
d) Proposed Lease of Land for Data Centre and Allied Infrastructure Project 
 
Accorded in-principle approval to the proposal for leasing land aggregating up to 100 
acres, from and out of the Company's existing land holdings at Sunguvarchatram, 
Tamil Nadu, to its wholly owned subsidiary, M/s. WSI-P&C Verticals Private Limited, 
for development and establishment of the proposed Data Centre and allied 
infrastructure project. 
 
The proposal is subject to identification of suitable land parcels, finalisation of the lease 
structure, commercial terms and conditions, determination of the lease consideration 
based on appropriate valuation, and obtaining the requisite approvals under the 

W.S. Industries (India) Limited 
 
 
 
P a g e  | 3 
Registered Office: 3rd Floor, New No.48, Old No. 21, Savidhaanu Building, Casa Major Road, Egmore, Chennai - 600 008, 
                                Tamil Nadu, India. 
Contact                : (91) - 89258 02400                                     CIN              : L42909TN1961PLC004568

                                                                                                   Website         : wsindustries.in 
applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013, including Sections 177 and 180(1)(a), 
wherever applicable, the SEBI LODR Regulations and other applicable statutory and 
regulatory requirements. 
 
The final terms and conditions of the proposed lease, together with the necessary 
approvals, shall be placed before the Board and/or the shareholders, as applicable, for 
consideration and approval. 
3. In-principle Approval for making strategic investments in EPC (Engineering, Procurement 
and Construction) business entities 
 
The Board accorded its in-principle approval for the strategic investment in EPC business 
entities, including private limited companies and limited liability partnerships, up to an 
aggregate amount of ₹3 crore, with a view to acquiring controlling interest, and to authorise 
the executive directors to undertake necessary due diligence and place detailed proposals 
before the board for its consideration and approval of Board/Shareholders as applicable. 
 
4. Further Corporate and Shareholders' Approvals  
The Board further noted and decided that the proposals requiring shareholders' approval, 
including the proposed alteration of the Memorandum of Association of the Company and the 
proposed lease of land, wherever such approval is required, shall be placed before the Board 
at a subsequent meeting for consideration and approval of the necessary procedural and 
consequential matters, including convening of an Extraordinary General Meeting, finalisation 
of its date, time and venue or mode of conducting the meeting, and approval of the requisite 
notices and explanatory statements. 
 
The aforesaid proposals are at an exploratory / in-principle approval stage, as applicable, and 
their implementation shall be subject to obtaining the requisite corporate, shareholders' and 
statutory approvals and completion of the applicable legal formalities. The Company reserves 
the right to modify, defer, reconsider or not proceed with any of the aforesaid proposals, in 
whole or in part, based on further evaluation, commercial considerations and the outcome of 
the requisite approval processes. Accordingly, the disclosures made herein should not be 
construed as a definitive commitment by the Company to implement or complete any such 
proposals. 
5. Securing of Civil Sub-contracts from M/s. CMK Projects Private Limited 
As approved by the Audit Committee at its meeting held on 18th November 2026, the Board 
took note that the Company has secured the following two civil-related sub-contracts from M/s.

Karnataka.

Nature and scope of work: Infrastructure Development for Smart Township of

You are requested to take the above information on record and acknowledge

PRESS RELEASE 
Tonbo Imaging wins order from the Ministry of Defence for its clip-on thermal weapon sights 
Bengaluru, 18 November 2026: Tonbo Imaging India Limited (NSE: TONBO; BSE: 544999) (“Tonbo” or the 
“Company”) has received an order from the Ministry of Defence, Government of India, for the supply of its clip-on 
thermal weapon sights and associated support equipment. 
The order is valued at approx. INR 35.62 crore, inclusive of taxes. Deliveries are to be completed in two lots within 52 
weeks. The order also includes an option clause and a repeat order clause, each for up to 50% of the ordered quantity, 
exercisable at the customer’s discretion. 
The clip-on thermal weapon sight is a compact, lightweight, uncooled thermal imager that mounts on an assault rifle to 
give the user night-fighting capability, and can also be used helmet-mounted or hand-held. It is designed, developed 
and manufactured by Tonbo in India. 
“Thermal weapon sights are a core Tonbo product line, built on our own imaging cores, optics and software. We are 
proud that the Ministry of Defence has chosen a sight designed and manufactured in India for its personnel. Delivering 
on schedule and supporting the equipment in the field is our immediate priority.” said Arvind Lakshmikumar, 
Founder, Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer, Tonbo Imaging India Limited. 
About Tonbo Imaging 
Tonbo Imaging India Limited is a global defence electronics original equipment manufacturer (OEM). The Company 
designs, develops and manufactures sensing, processing, communication and guidance systems for surveillance, 
reconnaissance, targeting and control. Its diversified product portfolio includes thermal imaging cores, weapon sights, 
hand-held thermal imaging binoculars, targeting systems, missile seekers, fire control systems and missile guidance 
systems, amongst others, to enable autonomy on the battlefield. The Company offers a diverse suite of field-proven 
electro-optic products that are designed and developed in India. The Company owns 100% of its intellectual property, 
ranging from optics to embedded software and electronics, and is a supplier under the Indigenously-Designed, 
Developed and Manufactured (IDDM) category of the Defence Acquisition Procedure 2020. Incorporated in 2003, the 
Company transitioned in 2012 into a defence-focused product manufacturing company. Its equity shares are listed on 
the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited. For more information, visit www.tonboimaging.com. 
Forward-looking statements: This release contains statements about the Company’s expectations that are subject to 
risks and uncertainties, including delivery schedules, acceptance of the equipment by the customer and the customer’s 
decision on exercising the option and repeat order clauses. Actual results may differ materially. The Company does 
not undertake to update these statements except as required by law.

Markolines Pavement Technologies Secures Infrastructure and Road 
Maintenance Work Orders Worth Rs. 234.83 Crore 
Three work orders cover a major bridge project and highway rehabilitation in Andaman & Nicobar 
Islands and road overlay works in Andhra Pradesh 
 
Mumbai, November 18, 2026: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited (BSE: 543364; NSE: 
MARKOLINES) has secured three work orders aggregating Rs. 234.83 crore (inclusive applicable GST) 
for infrastructure development and road maintenance projects in the Andaman & Nicobar Islands and 
Andhra Pradesh. With the addition of these orders, the Company's unexecuted order book stands at 
approximately ₹800 crore, providing strong revenue visibility and a robust foundation for future growth.   
 
The Company has received two work orders from RKEC Projects Limited, aggregating Rs.178.12 crore, 
for infrastructure and highway development in the Andaman & Nicobar Islands. The orders include bridge 
construction work valued at Rs.120.28 crore of a major bridge over Middle Strait Creek on NH-04, 
connecting South Andaman and Baratang Island, and highway rehabilitation and upgradation work worth 
Rs. 57.84 crore on the NH-4 stretch between End of Jarwa and Rangat. The two projects are scheduled 
for execution over 18 months and six months, respectively. 
 
Additionally, the Company has secured a work order, valued at Rs. 56.71 crore, awarded by Ranastalam 
Anandapuram Road Limited for major maintenance works across a 47-km stretch, in Andhra Pradesh. 
The project is scheduled for completion within six Months. 
 
Mr. Sanjay Patil, Founder, Chairman & Managing Director, Markolines Pavement Technologies 
Limited said, "These new work orders represent an important milestone in the Company's growth journey 
and reflect the confidence our clients place in Markolines' technical expertise and execution capabilities. 
In particular, the bridge construction project in the Andaman & Nicobar Islands marks a significant step 
towards our stated strategy of expanding into the marine infrastructure segment. It provides us with an 
opportunity to establish our presence in this specialised segment, develop relevant execution capabilities 
and leverage our engineering expertise across a wider infrastructure landscape. 
 
This diversification is a strategic extension of our existing capabilities and will enable us to participate in 
a broader range of infrastructure development opportunities. Alongside expanding our geographical 
footprint and strengthening our project portfolio, we remain focused on delivering specialised infrastructure 
solutions with high standards of quality, safety and execution, while creating sustainable long-term value 
for all stakeholders."  
 
Mr. Vijay Oswal, Founder & Chief Financial Officer, Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited said, 
"The addition of work orders worth ₹234.83 crore takes our unexecuted order book to approximately 
₹800 crore, significantly strengthening our revenue visibility. The diversified portfolio, comprising highway 
rehabilitation, major maintenance and bridge construction, provides us with opportunities to leverage our 
execution capabilities across multiple infrastructure segments. 
We remain focused on disciplined project execution, effective working capital management and operational 
efficiencies to ensure profitable and sustainable growth. The strengthened order book also provides a 
strong platform to capitalise on emerging opportunities in the infrastructure sector while maintaining our 
focus on financial discipline and long-term stakeholder value creation." 
 
These work orders mark an important addition to Markolines' infrastructure portfolio, strengthening its 
presence in highway development and maintenance while representing a strategic entry into the marine 
infrastructure segment, in line with the Company's diversification strategy   

Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited 
 
 
  
 
 
 
About Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited 
Established in 2002, Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited (Markolines) is one of India’s leading 
highway operations and maintenance (O&M) and specialized infrastructure solution providers. Markolines 
is the only listed company operating in this segment.  With a strong focus on innovation and execution 
excellence, the company offers the most comprehensive suite of services in highway maintenance – 
spanning from Major Maintenance & Repairs (MMR), Rigid Pavement (concrete road) Maintenance, 
specialised maintenance services and specialised construction activities. From reintroducing and reviving 
micro-surfacing in India, to bringing Cold In-Place Recycling (CIPR), Full Depth Reclamation (FDR), 
techniques into the mainstream, the company has consistently been at the forefront of technologies 
innovation. Headquartered in Navi Mumbai, Markolines has successfully executed over 5,730 lane 
kilometers of highway maintenance work across multiple states in India. The Company is recognized for 
several pioneering maintenance techniques in the Indian road maintenance sector and is leveraging its 
engineering expertise and specialized skill set to expand into other infrastructure segments such as 
Marine and Sports Infrastructure. 
 
Markolines migrated to the BSE Mainboard, commencing trading of its securities on June 12, 2025. 
Subsequently, the Company achieved another significant milestone with its listing on the NSE Mainboard 
in October 2025, enhancing its market visibility, liquidity and accessibility to a wider investor base. With 
a pan-India presence and a dedicated team of professionals, Markolines remains committed to enhancing 
the quality, safety and sustainability of India's road infrastructure while expanding its footprint across 
specialised infrastructure segments.

details.value: Protean eGov Technologies Limited received an Order in Appeal from the Office of the Commissioner of Central Tax Appeals in Bengaluru on November 17, 2026. The Commissioner rejected the company's appeal and upheld the original order regarding input tax credit and supplies to a distinct person. The upheld order imposes a penalty of Rs. 5,64,81,103 under Section 74 of the CGST Act. It also levies interest of Rs. 2,33,62,444 for delayed GST payment. Additionally, a penalty of Rs. 4,53,60,000 was imposed for supplies to a distinct person. The company considers the demand not maintainable. It is evaluating options to file a further appeal before the GST Appellate Tribunal. The company states there is no envisaged impact on its financials, operations, or other activities.

Mumbai, 18th November 2026 
Press Release        For Immediate Publication 
 
HIRECT receives a leƩer of acceptance for Appx. ₹ 136.26 Crore Order from ChiƩaranjan LocomoƟve 
Works for 900 TracƟon Motors for WAG-9 Electric LocomoƟves 
Hirect Limited (formerly known as Hind Rectifiers Limited) has received a Letter of Acceptance (LOA) from 
Chittaranjan Locomotive Works (CLW), Indian Railways, for the supply of 900 three-phase asynchronous 
traction motors, marking a significant milestone in the Company's railway business. The order, valued at 
approximately ₹136.26 crore, further strengthens HIRECT's presence in the railway traction segment and 
reinforces its capabilities in delivering critical electrical solutions for Indian Railways. 
The order comprises 900 units of three-phase asynchronous tracƟon motors, designed for WAG-9 electric 
locomoƟves. The supplies are scheduled to be executed in a phased manner between January 2027 and 
December 2027. The order also carries a warranty period of 78 months from the date of delivery, reﬂecƟng 
the criƟcal role and long-term operaƟonal requirements of these components in railway applicaƟons.  
This order represents an important opportunity for HIRECT to further strengthen its capabiliƟes in railway 
tracƟon technologies and expand its contribuƟon to the modernisaƟon of Indian Railways. With its 
established experƟse in power electronics, motors, transformers and railway technologies, the Company 
conƟnues to focus on developing reliable, high-performance indigenous soluƟons for the evolving 
requirements of the railway sector. 
CommenƟng on the development, Mr. Suramya NevaƟa, Chairman & Managing Director, said " We are 
pleased to receive this LeƩer of Acceptance from ChiƩaranjan LocomoƟve Works, marking another important 
milestone in our journey of strengthening our railway business. This order reﬂects the conﬁdence placed in

GATEWAY DISTRIPARKS WINS CONTRACT TO OPERATE COMMON RAIL YARD AT JNPA 
New Delhi, November 18, 2026: Gateway Distriparks Limited (GDL) has been awarded an 8-year 
contract for the operations and management of the Dedicated Freight Corridor (DFC)-compliant 
common rail yard terminal at Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority (JNPA) at Nhava Sheva. 
The common rail yard terminal forms an important part of JNPA's rail infrastructure, facilitating the 
handling of mixed container trains carrying cargo destined for different container terminals within JNPA. 
Of the five rail terminals within the port, this is one of only two facilities equipped with 1,500-metre-
long DFC-compatible railway lines, designed to accommodate long-haul container trains and enable 
efficient handling and movement of rail-bound import and export cargo. 
Under the contract, Gateway will be responsible for the operations and management of this common 
rail yard terminal, including train handling and placement within the terminal, segregation of mixed 
container trains, container handling and stacking, inter-terminal transfers and associated yard activities. 
This will help support more efficient train handling, improved coordination and optimal utilisation of the 
port's rail infrastructure. 
Prem Kishan Dass Gupta, Chairman & Managing Director, Gateway Distriparks Limited, 
commented: 
"We are pleased to take on this responsibility at JNPA, which is an important gateway for India's 
international trade. Rail connectivity plays a vital role in moving containers efficiently to and from the 
port, and we look forward to bringing our experience in rail operations to this facility. Our focus will be 
on working closely with JNPA and the port terminals to ensure smooth train movements, better 
coordination and reliable service for everyone using the rail network." 
The award represents a strategic expansion of Gateway's service portfolio beyond its established 
container rail transportation, Inland Container Depot (ICD) and Container Freight Station (CFS) 
operations. It further strengthens the company's presence at JNPA, where Gateway already operates a 
CFS, while establishing a platform to pursue similar management opportunities across India. 
About Gateway Distriparks Limited 
Gateway Distriparks Limited is one of India's leading integrated multimodal logistics companies, 
providing container rail transportation, inland container depot and container freight station services. 
The company operates an extensive network of rail-linked inland terminals and container freight 
stations, offering integrated logistics solutions to importers, exporters and shipping lines. Gateway is 
focused on strengthening India's rail-led logistics infrastructure and facilitating efficient movement of 
containerised cargo across the country. 
For more information, please visit www.gatewaydistriparks.com.

ACME Solar signs PPA with NTPC for  
150 MW ISTS-connected Hybrid Project  
 
GURUGRAM, November 18, 2026: ACME Solar Holdings Limited (ACME Solar), through its subsidiary, 
ACME Alpha Renewable Private Limited, has signed a Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with NTPC 
Limited (“NTPC”) for a 150 MW Inter-State Transmission System (ISTS)-connected Hybrid power 
project at a tariﬀ of INR 3.21 per unit under NTPC’s Hybrid-IV tranche. The tariﬀ for this project has 
already been adopted by Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (CERC).  
 
This hybrid project, spanning across Bhadla in Rajasthan, Jambkhabalia in Gujarat & Mandsaur  in 
Madhya Pradesh, will integrate renewable energy of Solar & Wind with appropriate energy storage 
solu/g415ons. It is designed to deliver reliable and dispatchable power throughout the day, while mee/g415ng 
the o/g335akers’ power requirements during peak demand hours. CTU transmission connec/g415vity for the 
project has been secured for Jambkhabalia & Mandsaur.  
 
Commen/g415ng on the power purchase agreement signed, Nikhil Dhingra, Joint MD & CEO of ACME 
Solar said,  “This PPA with NTPC reinforces our focus on delivering reliable renewable power aligned 
with the evolving needs of India’s energy market. By combining solar, wind and energy storage, the 
project will help meet peak-hour demand and suppor/g415ng India’s clean energy transi/g415on.” 
 
This project is an important step in ACME Solar’s goal to signiﬁcantly contribute to India’s clean energy 
transi/g415on. Following this PPA, the under construc/g415on PPA-locked contracted por/g414olio now stands at 
5,080 MW  out of total under construc/g415on contracted capacity of 5,380 MW.  
 
About ACME Solar: ACME Solar Holdings Limited is a leading integrated renewable energy player with 
a diversiﬁed contracted por/g414olio of 8,370 MW spanning Solar, BESS, FDRE, Hybrid and Wind  solu/g415ons 
and an opera/g415onal capacity of ~3,190  MW and 5.90 GWh of BESS capacity. With an in-house EPC and 
O&M division, the company does end-to-end development and O&M of the plants, thereby delivering 
projects in a /g415me & cost-eﬀec/g415ve manner while ensuring best in class opera/g415ng performance evident 
in its industry leading CUF and opera/g415ng margins.

Dear Sir/Madam, 
Sub: Disclosure nuder Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ("LODR Regulations") - Update on Divestment 
from captive wind power project 
This has reference to earlier letter dated l 0th April 2023 informing the stock exchanges 
regarding the Company's equity investment of 39.08% in Ulric Renewables Private Limited 
("Ulric"), a special purpose vehicle promoted and incorporated by Cleantech Solar India OA 
2 Pte. Ltd. ("CIOA2") for development of captive wind power projects aggregating 18.9 MW 
for supplying renewable power to the Company's manufacturing facilities in Tamil Nadu and 
Maharashtra. 
As a further update, we wish to inform you that captive wind power project having a 
contracted capacity of 10.5 MW at Jath, Maharashtra for the Maharashtra factories could not 
be commissioned within the scheduled commencement date. Accordingly, pursuant to 
mutually agreed terms between Ulric, the Company and CIOA2, including amendment and 
settlement documentation executed by the parties, Exide has diluted its shareholding in Ulric 
from 39.08% to to 26.07%. 
The captive wind power project for the Company's Hosur facility, Tamil Nadu, continues to 
remain operational under the existing arrangement, and Ulric shall continue to supply 
electricity from the wind power project having a contracted capacity of 8.4 MW to the Hosur 
facility.

Subject: L1 for National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) Project

2015, Ashoka Buildcon Limited (“the Company”) informs that the Company had submitted bid for 
the following Project of National Highways Authority of India (NHAI).  
 
Further to apprise that the Company has been declared as the Lowest Bidder (L-1) for the said 
Project.  
 
The quoted EPC Price for the Project is Rs.1465 Crore, excl. GST. 
 
The details required pursuant to Master Circular No. HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 
dated January 30, 2026 are given in Annexure I. 
 
This is for your kind information.  
 
Yours faithfully, 
For Ashoka Buildcon Limited

details.value: Kalpataru Limited has informed the Exchange about the receipt of Regional Director confirmation Order for the Scheme of Arrangement (Merger by Absorption) of Kalpataru Hills Residency Private Limited, a step-down wholly-owned subsidiary with Kalpataru Properties (Thane) Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company

details.label: Exchange field · Voice Summary
details.value: Kalpataru Limited confirms receipt of the Regional Director confirmation order dated November 18, 2026, approving the Scheme of Arrangement for the merger by absorption of Kalpataru Hills Residency Private Limited with Kalpataru Properties Thane Limited. The order was filed with the Registrar of Companies Mumbai-I on November 23, 2026, making the Scheme effective on that date. Consequently, Kalpataru Hills Residency Private Limited stands dissolved and ceases to be a step-down subsidiary of Kalpataru Limited. The merger is sanctioned under Section 233 of the Companies Act 2013 with an appointed date of April 1, 2026. The Transferor Company held 18,00,000 equity shares of Rs. 10 each as of March 31, 2026.

Subject: Intimation regarding the receipt of Regional Director confirmation Order for the

Limited, a step-down wholly-owned subsidiary with Kalpataru Properties (Thane)
Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Kalpataru Limited (“KL” or “the Company”)

Reference: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure
Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”)
Dear Sir/Madam,
We refer to our earlier intimation dated July 8, 2026, wherein we had informed about the approval
of the Scheme of Arrangement (Merger by Absorption) (“Scheme”) of Kalpataru Hills Residency
Private Limited (“Transferor Company”), a step-down wholly-owned subsidiary with Kalpataru
Properties (Thane) Limited (“Transferee Company”), a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company
and their respective shareholders (“the Scheme”), by the respective Board of Directors of the
Transferor Company and the Transferee Company. In this regard, we wish to further inform that,
Regional Director, Western Region-I vide his Order (“RD Order”) dated November 18, 2026
(attached herewith as “Annexure A”) has approved the Scheme under Section 233 of the
Companies Act, 2013.
The RD Order sanctioning the Scheme was filed by the respective companies with the Registrar of
Companies, Mumbai-I (“ROC”) on November 23, 2026, on which date the Scheme became
effective. Consequently, the Transferor Company stands dissolved and ceases to be a step-down
subsidiary of the Company.
The Company has received information from both the Companies about the filing of respective
forms with ROC, on November 23, 2026 at 06:40 p.m.
Please take the information on record.
This information is also simultaneously disseminated on the website of the Company at
https://www.kalpataru.com/investor-corner.
Thanking You,
Yours faithfully,
For Kalpataru Limited
Gajendra Mewara
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE 
RMC Switchgears receives Letter of Intent for an estimated ₹521.84 crore turnkey distribution-
infrastructure package in Maharashtra  
 
The proposed work package covers substations, transformers, HT lines and allied infrastructure 
under an ADB-funded programme 
 
Jaipur, 24 November 2026: RMC Switchgears Limited (NSE: RMC; BSE: 540358), a power 
infrastructure, engineering and EPC solutions company, has received a Letter of Intent for the 
development of distribution infrastructure and system strengthening works, covering the construction 
of new substations, augmentation of existing substations, additional power transformers, HT lines and 
allied works. 
 
The package includes the supply, testing, transportation, construction, erection, testing and 
commissioning of new substations; augmentation of existing substations; additional power 
transformers; HT lines; and other allied distribution works. It also includes the associated civil works, 
plant and equipment, installation and performance-guarantee responsibilities. 
 
The estimated basic order cost is ₹521.84 crore.  
 
Mr. Ankit Agarwal, CEO & Whole-time Director, RMC Switchgears Limited, said: 
 
“This is a significant opportunity for RMC to demonstrate its end-to-end execution capability on a complex, 
utility-grade distribution-infrastructure programme. The ADR package spans the full project lifecycle - 
from civil works and equipment supply through installation, commissioning and performance assurance - 
and reinforces our ability to deliver integrated electrical EPC solutions at scale. 
 
“The engagement further builds on our experience in Maharashtra and strengthens our credentials in 
high-value distribution infrastructure. We remain focused on disciplined execution, rigorous project 
controls and delivering dependable outcomes for the utility ecosystem.” 
 
The engagement is expected to strengthen RMC’s electrical EPC execution pipeline and expand its 
participation in India’s distribution-network modernisation opportunity. It also builds on the 
Company’s existing experience of distribution infrastructure work in Jalna and Satara. 
 
About RMC Switchgears Limited 
 
RMC Switchgears Limited (NSE: RMC; BSE: 540358) is a Jaipur-based power infrastructure and 
electrical-engineering company with over three decades of experience. The Company delivers 
integrated solutions across electrical products, power-distribution and transmission EPC, solar EPC and 
smart-grid infrastructure, combining manufacturing, engineering, project execution and O&M 
capabilities. Its portfolio includes smart-meter enclosures, feeder pillars, distribution boxes, electrical  
panels and the IS 14772-certified PulseBox™ smart LT distribution box. RMC serves state utilities, 
DISCOMs, PSUs, AMISPs and EPC partners, supporting the modernisation, reliability and sustainability

RMC Switchgears receives Letter of Intent for an estimated ₹521.84 crore turnkey distribution-
infrastructure package in Maharashtra  
 
The proposed work package covers substations, transformers, HT lines and allied infrastructure 
under an ADB-funded programme 
 
Jaipur, 24 November 2026: RMC Switchgears Limited (NSE: RMC; BSE: 540358), a power 
infrastructure, engineering and EPC solutions company, has received a Letter of Intent for the 
development of distribution infrastructure and system strengthening works, covering the construction 
of new substations, augmentation of existing substations, additional power transformers, HT lines and 
allied works. 
 
The package includes the supply, testing, transportation, construction, erection, testing and 
commissioning of new substations; augmentation of existing substations; additional power 
transformers; HT lines; and other allied distribution works. It also includes the associated civil works, 
plant and equipment, installation and performance-guarantee responsibilities. 
 
The estimated basic order cost is ₹521.84 crore.  
 
Mr. Ankit Agarwal, CEO & Whole-time Director, RMC Switchgears Limited, said: 
 
“This is a significant opportunity for RMC to demonstrate its end-to-end execution capability on a complex, 
utility-grade distribution-infrastructure programme. The ADR package spans the full project lifecycle - 
from civil works and equipment supply through installation, commissioning and performance assurance - 
and reinforces our ability to deliver integrated electrical EPC solutions at scale. 
 
“The engagement further builds on our experience in Maharashtra and strengthens our credentials in 
high-value distribution infrastructure. We remain focused on disciplined execution, rigorous project 
controls and delivering dependable outcomes for the utility ecosystem.” 
 
The engagement is expected to strengthen RMC’s electrical EPC execution pipeline and expand its 
participation in India’s distribution-network modernisation opportunity. It also builds on the 
Company’s existing experience of distribution infrastructure work in Jalna and Satara. 
 
About RMC Switchgears Limited 
 
RMC Switchgears Limited (NSE: RMC; BSE: 540358) is a Jaipur-based power infrastructure and 
electrical-engineering company with over three decades of experience. The Company delivers 
integrated solutions across electrical products, power-distribution and transmission EPC, solar EPC and 
smart-grid infrastructure, combining manufacturing, engineering, project execution and O&M 
capabilities. Its portfolio includes smart-meter enclosures, feeder pillars, distribution boxes, electrical  
panels and the IS 14772-certified PulseBox™ smart LT distribution box. RMC serves state utilities, 
DISCOMs, PSUs, AMISPs and EPC partners, supporting the modernisation, reliability and sustainability

In furtherance to the Company's disclosure dated October 23, 2026 and earlier intimations regarding transfer pricing

source_data.voiceSummary: Updater Services Limited received an order from the Office of the Deputy Commissioner in Chennai for Rs. 2,97,67,691 under Section 73 of the CGST Act, 2017. The order is dated 24th November 2026. The tax authority cited issues regarding rate of tax verification, credit notes, ineligible input tax credit, and reverse charge mechanism. The company states the order was passed without considering its response. Updater Services Limited is exploring legal options, including filing an appeal. The company assesses the order as devoid of merits. It expects the financial impact to be NIL. The company is hopeful of no significant financial impact. This intimation is filed under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

L&T Wins (Significant*) Order 
for Battery Energy Storage System in Gujarat 
Mumbai, November 25, 2026: Two L&T verticals – the Renewables business and L&T Electronic 
Products & Systems (LTEPS) - have jointly won an order to develop a 300 MW / 900 MWh Battery 
Energy Storage System (BESS) at Khavda in Gujarat.  
The project will feature a three-hour BESS, with a power capacity of 300 MW and an energy 
storage capacity of 900 MWh. By storing surplus renewable energy during periods of high 
generation and releasing it during peak demand, it will help maximise clean-energy utilisation, 
strengthen grid stability, and enhance the flexibility and reliability of power supply. 
The advanced BESS solution will incorporate liquid-cooling technology to deliver higher power 
density, enhanced safety and a longer operating life. The facility will play a crucial role in 
improving grid flexibility and enabling greater integration of renewable energy into India's 
power network. 
The order further strengthens L&T's position in the energy storage sector and reflects the trust 
and confidence that clients place in the Company's ability to deliver complex projects at scale.

Highway Infrastructure Limited Secures ₹12 Crore Work Order for Development of 
Highway Aerocity Residential Project 
 
 
 
Madhya Pradesh, India 25th November 2026: Highway Infrastructure Limited (HIL), an integrated 
infrastructure platform with established capabilities across Tolling, EPC, and Real Estate, is pleased to announce 
that it has received a Work Order from Sacham Highway Real Estates Private Limited for the development and 
construction of its residential project, “Highway Aerocity,” located at Village Garakhedi, Tehsil Bagli, District 
Dewas, Madhya Pradesh. The Work Order carries an approximate value of Rs. 12.00 crore, plus applicable 
GST, subject to variations depending upon site conditions. 
 
The project involves the development and construction of a residential project spread across the designated land 
parcels at Village Garakhedi, Madhya Pradesh. The scope of work encompasses the development and 
construction activities associated with the Highway Aerocity residential project. 
 
The project is scheduled to be executed over a period of two years. This mandate further strengthens HIL's 
presence in the Real Estate segment and aligns with the Company's strategy of diversifying its business portfolio 
across infrastructure and allied development activities. The project reflects the Company's execution capabilities 
and reinforces its commitment to expanding its presence in the real estate development and construction space. 
 
Speaking on the development, Mr. Arun Kumar Jain, Managing Director, Highway Infrastructure 
Limited said: “We are pleased to have received the Work Order from Sacham Highway Real Estates Private 
Limited for the development and construction of the Highway Aerocity residential project. This project marks 
an important milestone in strengthening our presence in the Real Estate segment and further diversifies our 
business portfolio across infrastructure and allied development activities. With a planned execution period of 
two years, the project provides an opportunity to leverage our established execution capabilities and project 
management expertise in the real estate sector. We remain focused on expanding our business across our core 
segments, pursuing emerging opportunities and creating sustainable long-term value for our stakeholders.” 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
Highway Infrastructure Ltd 
 
57-FA, Scheme No. 94, Pipliyahana Junction, Ring Road, Indore, Madhya Pradesh - 452016 
 
 
About Highway Infrastructure Limited: 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Incorporated in 2006, Highway Infrastructure Limited is an integrated infrastructure company with presence 
across Tollway Collection, EPC and Real Estate. With operations spanning 11 states and 1 Union Territory, the 
Company has established capabilities in Tollway Operations and Infrastructure project execution, supported by 
technology-driven processes and an experienced management team. Under the leadership of Mr. Arun Kumar 
Jain, the Company has built a strong track record across its business verticals and continues to focus on 
expanding its presence in the infrastructure sector. With a growing order book and a healthy project pipeline, 
Highway Infrastructure Limited remains focused on pursuing sustainable growth opportunities across India's 
infrastructure and transportation landscape. 
 
 
For more information, please contact:  
Highway Infrastructure Limited 
Palak Rathore 
cs@highwayinfrastructure.in
